instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize HIGH SPEED and LOW CLICK COUNT for Nova Venda (Counter POS flow). Staff needs fast item adding, quantity shortcuts, m² calculator modal/popover, variation picks, and quick checkout.

Ensure total dark mode consistency: main background #09090B, cards #18181B with thin subtle #27272A borders, crisp white headers, vibrant accent badges in pink (#EC4899), cyan (#06B6D4), and yellow (#EAB308) matching Rio Sul logo identity.
Include data-testid on every interactive element, modal, input, button, select, filter, and table row for reliable E2E tests.
Provide clear feedback with Sonner toasts for sales completion, voucher authorization, cash closing, ZPL tag conversion, and CSV import.
Ensure full responsiveness across Desktop (primary target), Tablet, and Mobile views.
Never rely on default transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, select items, popovers, or floating headers — always use solid/glass dark surfaces like bg-zinc-900/95 or bg-zinc-950/95.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='pos-add-to-cart-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Do not use raw emoji characters like 🤖, 🛒, 💵 for UI icons; use Lucide React icons exclusively.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure primary text is #FAFAFA or #FFFFFF over dark #18181B surfaces with clear contrast.
